rationale: Declare HPO_RELEASE and OPENTARGETS_RELEASE beside the assets: each source file with its URL, size and digest; each table with its relation, cache file and row count; the reader's assumptions. Give RemoteSourcePlanner a RemoteSourceConfiguration(asset, release), encode it in the instruction payload, and let the executor read only that payload. Delete the two data-side manifests. A missing table rebuilds from the declaration, and workflow_plan.json records exactly what will be fetched and verified.
subject: pharos_kg/asset/release.py
title: Declare the releases beside the assets and record the fetch config in the plan
